# A content change propagates through depends_on and output references,
# but not through after, which only orders.
bit
grep '\Aone\n\z' source.out
grep 'coupled' runs.log
grep 'ordered' runs.log
grep '\Ahello\z' sub/out.txt
grep '\Ahello\z' uses.txt

bit
stdout 'coupled · no changes'
stdout 'ordered · no changes'

cp src.txt.changed src.txt
bit
stdout 'source ▶ .*\(.src\.txt. changed\)'
stdout 'coupled ▶ .*\(.source. changed\)'
stdout 'ordered · no changes'
grep '\Acoupled\nordered\ncoupled\n\z|\Aordered\ncoupled\ncoupled\n\z' runs.log

# after still orders: the ordered target starts after source finishes.
bit --graph ordered
stdout 'source'

# dir sets where commands run and relative paths resolve, env sets the
# command's environment, and a changed env value reruns the target and
# those using its outputs.
env GREETING=bye
bit sub uses
stdout 'sub ▶'
stdout 'uses ▶'
grep '\Abye\z' sub/out.txt
grep '\Abye\z' uses.txt
! exists out.txt

-- BUILD.bit --
source = exec {
  command = "cat src.txt > source.out"
  inputs = ["src.txt"]
  outputs = "source.out"
}

coupled = exec {
  command = "echo coupled >> runs.log"
  inputs = []
  depends_on = [source]
}

ordered = exec {
  command = "echo ordered >> runs.log"
  inputs = []
  after = [source]
}

sub = exec {
  dir = "sub"
  env = { GREETING = env("GREETING", "hello") }
  command = "printf \"$GREETING\" > out.txt"
  outputs = "out.txt"
}

uses = exec {
  command = "cat #{sub.path} > uses.txt"
  outputs = "uses.txt"
}
-- src.txt --
one
-- src.txt.changed --
two
-- sub/.keep --
